title: Why Do Fingers Get Wrinkly in Water?
short_title: Why Fingers Wrinkle in Water (It's Not Soaking!)
description: Why do your fingers turn wrinkly after a long bath? It is not what most people think.
comment: How fast do your fingers wrinkle? 🛁

scenes.text: Why do your fingers turn wrinkly after a long bath?
For years people thought skin just soaked up water and swelled.
But it is your nerves. Water makes them tighten tiny blood vessels under the skin.
The skin shrinks and wrinkles in a pattern, like the grooves on a rain tyre.
These grooves may channel water away, so you can grip wet things better.
So wrinkly fingers are a smart upgrade!
